$comment: Cases that do not match Node yet, by target (tests/README.md): each with its owner, its cause, and its signature, text the failure's one-line description holds. The diff run reports them without failing; it fails when one fails otherwise, or matches Node so it is removed here.

1046-library-symbol-converts.cause: Core's own code reads an untyped value where it declares a number with the lenient cell (`jsLenientNumber`), which gives NaN for a Symbol, unless the function around it already throws by the throws analysis's count; the analysis does not count library conversions (no kit signature changes), so a `try` around such a call is dropped. Swift failed-read decision O3 (VM3).
1046-library-symbol-converts.signature: line 3: node "size threw true Cannot convert a Symbol value to a number" native "size: NaN"

1522-wtf-constructor-property.signature: line 1: node "c[c] true true" native "c[c] false false"

1525-wtf-untyped-tag.cause: A tagged template whose tag is held untyped is emitted as a call of an `Any?`.
1525-wtf-untyped-tag.signature: cannot call value of non-function type 'Any?'

1526-function-length-name.cause: A function's `length` and `name` are not translated.
1526-function-length-name.signature: value of type '(Any?, Any?, JSArray<Any?>) -> Double' has no member 'length'

1527-this-parameter-call.cause: apply on a function declaring a `this` parameter passes its argument array unconverted.
1527-this-parameter-call.signature: cannot convert value of type 'JSArray<Any?>' to expected argument type 'JSArray<Double>'

1528-class-prototype-object.cause: A class's `prototype` read does not compile.

1530-wtf-function-constructor.cause: `new` on a function expression held untyped throws TypeError instead of constructing an object.
1530-wtf-function-constructor.signature: line 1: node "new function ctor { a: 1 }" native "new function TypeError"

1561-wtf-class-field-semicolons.cause: A class field with a computed literal key (`['array'] = …`) is named by its source text.
1561-wtf-class-field-semicolons.signature: line 1: node "new SomeClass().array str [ 'array' ] str" native "new SomeClass().array undefined [ \"['array']\" ] str"

1566-wtf-proto-chain.cause: `__proto__` read through an untyped value is neither refused (proto) nor followed: it reads undefined.

1567-wtf-call-call.cause: `call` read from a function held untyped is undefined.

1573-wtf-regexp-addition.cause: `RegExp` read as a value (RegExp.prototype) is neither refused (builtin-prototype) nor emitted.

1836-detached-method-receiver.cause: A method value is bound to an object (a class's method value to the object it is read from, a literal's method to the literal it is made in): called alone it still reads that object, not undefined. Needs function values that take their receiver at the call.

1889-typed-field-delete-define.cause: A typed object's declared field is a stored property: `delete` through an untyped value returns true and keeps the field and its key, and Object.defineProperty cannot make it read-only, hidden or non-configurable (TypeError "Cannot restrict a typed object's field").
1889-typed-field-delete-define.signature: line 1: node "true false undefined a" native "true true 2 a,b"

1899-inspect-holes.cause: A JSArray<Any?> keeps no holes (only arrays of numbers and strings have a hole marker): `new Array(n)`, `delete a[i]` and a longer `length` hold undefined, which console.log prints as such.
1899-inspect-holes.signature: line 3: node "[ <3 empty items> ]" native "[ undefined, undefined, undefined ]"

247-missing-values-throw.cause: A module const read before its declaration runs, and a member of undefined or null read, set or called, trap instead of throwing ReferenceError or TypeError.
247-missing-values-throw.signature: line 1: node "early ReferenceError Cannot access 'settings' before initialization" native ""

862-json-unrepresentable.cause: Limit: a lone surrogate JSON.parse reads becomes U+FFFD (a Swift string holds whole characters), and JSON.stringify recurses per nesting level, so 5000 nested arrays overflow the stack where V8 writes them iteratively.

945-regexp-lone-surrogates.cause: Limit: a match that starts or ends inside a surrogate pair, or an input holding a lone surrogate, gives a lone surrogate, which a Swift string cannot hold: it becomes U+FFFD.

1881-null-prototype-inspect.cause: jsInspect prints an object made by `Object.create(null)` as a plain object, without Node's `[Object: null prototype]` tag.

1527-this-parameter-call.cause: A function declaring a `this` parameter reads `this` where its Kotlin function has none.

1528-class-prototype-object.cause: Object.getPrototypeOf of a derived class is not its base, and a method read from a class's prototype is undefined.
